account: It is day 0, about 09:09, and I am in the town hall office with the secretary. Today’s appointments are a market walk at the plaza at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at an east-bank dockside cottage at 15:00, a return to the office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I do not yet know precisely which cottage hosts tea. The secretary says there is no correspondence or urgent news yet. The only unusual detail is that the secretary has asked again to review the appointment book even though I already handed it over; I can now see the secretary holding a writable book. This may simply be a misunderstanding while preparing my meetings, and I have no evidence of any other purpose. Three townsfolk are visible near the town hall, but I have not heard anything from them or seen anything that establishes their business. For now, town business appears routine; I should clarify the schedule with the secretary and keep my appointments.
